# Manage inventory order fulfillment and returns

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When the company holds physical stock or is responsible for delivering physical customer orders. Reconciled stock and order records with accepted delivery, returns and discrepancies assigned.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Reconcile items, locations and demand

agent-runnable


Maintain item identifiers, stock locations, available and reserved quantities, lead times and order commitments. Distinguish accepted stock from quarantine, damaged or consigned goods.

- Sources: [CPSC manufacturing best practices](https://www.cpsc.gov/business--manufacturing/business-education/business-guidance/BestPractices) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve inventory and fulfillment controls

human · human approval required


Operations and finance agree purchasing authority, reorder assumptions, custody, picking checks and reconciliation cadence. Review product, customs and customer commitments with specialists where required.

- Sources: [CPSC manufacturing best practices](https://www.cpsc.gov/business--manufacturing/business-education/business-guidance/BestPractices) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Process the authorized order and dispatch records

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators validate the order, payment or credit approval, item and destination before release. Record lot or serial traceability and the agreed carrier and delivery evidence.

- Sources: [CPSC manufacturing best practices](https://www.cpsc.gov/business--manufacturing/business-education/business-guidance/BestPractices) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Handle delivery exceptions and returns

human · human approval required


Verify the customer, product and reason for any return or failed delivery. Use approved inspection, quarantine, refund and replacement decisions rather than returning potentially unsafe product directly to available stock.

- Sources: [CPSC manufacturing best practices](https://www.cpsc.gov/business--manufacturing/business-education/business-guidance/BestPractices) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile stock, customer balances and losses

agent-runnable


Match physical counts, movements, receipts and credits with the systems and ledger. Investigate discrepancies, approve adjustments through the responsible owner and update replenishment and quality actions.

- Verify: Reconciled stock and order records with accepted delivery, returns and discrepancies assigned.
- Sources: [CPSC manufacturing best practices](https://www.cpsc.gov/business--manufacturing/business-education/business-guidance/BestPractices) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)
